claims.text: Artificial Intelligence does not act as a significant predictor of 21st-century pedagogy.
claims.quote: AI ( = 0. 195, t = 1. 762, p > 0. 083) does not act as a significant predictor of 21st-century pedagogy

claims.text: The cognitive science approach to education focuses on developing higher-order thinking and problem-solving skills rather than teaching facts through expository lectures.
claims.quote: Rather than focusing on teaching facts through expository lectures or demonstrations, the emphasis is, instead, on developing higher-order, thinking and problem-solving skills.

claims.text: Industrial Revolution 4.0 is a significant predictor of 21st-century pedagogy among pre-service history teachers.
claims.quote: IR 4. 0 ( = 0. 359, t = 3. 254, p < 0. 002) is a significant predictor.

claims.text: History education can help students develop the ability to think critically, creatively, wisely, empathically, and independently.
claims.quote: Through history education, students can understand all kinds of national problems with historical messages, so that students have the ability to think critically, creatively, wisely, empathically, independently
